Chapter 432 - 432 Explanation; Something Happened! (2)

Chapter 432 - 432 Explanation; Something Happened! (2)

432 Explanation; Something Happened! (2)

Lin Fan nodded at everyone. Then, he turned around and opened a bag of premium beef cat food.

The cat, Lil White, made a purring sound as it ate.

“It’s delicious. It’s good that Master is here!”

“You’re so greedy!” Hao Zhiwu spat softly.

Then, he took a stack of draft paper and said, “Professor Lin, I have a problem here…”

Lin Fan took a casual glance and picked up a pen to write quickly.

Soon, a long reaction equation appeared on the draft paper.

“I see. I was wondering why I couldn’t solve it.” Hao Zhiwu suddenly understood.”

“Professor Lin, where have you been these days?” Hao Zhiwu asked after a pause.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, and the others could not help but perk up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very curious.

Lin Fan said, “Didn’t you say last time… that you want a device that allows you to enter the game with your consciousness?”

Hao Zhiwu nodded.

However, his face was still filled with confusion.

He had said this before.

However, what did this have to do with his problem?

It could not be that he had been creating equipment for consciousness to enter the game these past few days, right?

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

“Professor Lin, Professor Lin!”

Before the person arrived, there was an excited shout.

Soon, biology professors Wu Tian and Zheng Qian rushed into the office.

Wu Tian exclaimed, “Professor Lin, your latest thesis published on Nature, The Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets, is really amazing!”

Silence!

The entire office was silent!

Although Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, and the others, did not know what kind of paper it was, they all understood what it meant to publish a paper in Nature.

Lin Fan had not come to the office for the past few days because he was writing this thesis?

He wrote a paper for Nature in a few days?!

This…

This…

In the past, they often heard people say that Professor Lin Fan was a genius!

It was as easy as eating a meal for him to publish a paper in top journals like Nature and Science.

At that time, they did not believe it.

Now, they did!

Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian were dumbfounded.

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s pretty faces were full of admiration.

“Professor Lin, you wrote a thesis on gaming helmets?” Hao Zhiwu shouted excitedly.

Lin Fan scratched his ears and said, “Yes.”

“Can I take a look? Can I take a look?” Hao Zhiwu asked hurriedly.

Just like what he said a few days ago, he liked games.

In fact, the reason why he chose bioengineering was to create equipment for consciousness to enter the game.

Now, when Hao Zhiwu heard that Lin Fan had published a thesis on gaming helmets in Nature, how could he not be excited?

This meant that there was progress in the gaming helmet, big progress!

Zheng Qian handed over the journal.

Hao Zhiwu quickly flipped through it like a treasure.

However, he frowned very soon after.

There were many things inside that he could not understand at all.

At this moment, Wu Tian said, “Professor Lin, we didn’t help at all this time. In the end, our names appeared as the second authors again. It’s really… We’re really too ashamed to accept it.”

“Yeah,” Zheng Qian added.

Although they said so, their faces were flushed and filled with joy.

It was no wonder that Wu Tian and Zheng Qian were like this.

Within a year, they published two articles in top journals.

Even if it was as the second author, that was something they did not even dare to think about in the past.

What kind of glory was this?

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “This is what you deserve.”

Then, Wu Tian and Zheng Qian asked Lin Fan some questions about the nervous system in the thesis.

“Thank you for your patience, Professor Lin,” Wu Tian said. “Let’s go back and study this thesis. We won’t disturb Professor Lin’s lecture now.

After saying that, he walked out with Zheng Qian.

At this moment, Zheng Qian seemed to have thought of something and said, “By the way, Professor Lin. Do you know what happened to Hu Tian’s family?”

“What happened?” Lin Fan asked.

“Two days ago, I saw Hu Tian in a hurry to go home and asked her about it…” Zheng Qian said. “She didn’t say anything. I thought you knew… It should be nothing.”

Lin Fan looked at Zheng Qian and Wu Tian’s receding figures. After some hesitation, he took out his phone and sent Hu Tian a WeChat message.

Lin Fan: [Teacher Tiantian, you went home?]

However, Hu Tian did not reply after a long time.

Lin Fan understood that something must have happened to Hu Tian’s family.

Hence, he made a call.

After a while, a tired voice came from the other end.

“Lin Fan…”

“Teacher Tiantian, you went home?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes,” Hu Tian said.

“Did something happen at home?” Lin Fan asked again.

Hu Tian was silent for a moment before she said in a hoarse voice, “My second brother is injured.”

Although Hu Tian did not specifically say what kind of injury he had suffered, Lin Fan knew that he was definitely heavily injured!

Otherwise, she would not be so sad.

In addition, Lin Fan had some interactions with Hu Tian’s second brother and knew that his name was Hu Shaodong.

At first, Hu Shaodong wanted to show Lin Fan his strength through racing.

As they got to know each other, he found that Hu Shaodong was a resolute and iron-blooded person, so his overall impression of him was not bad.

Of course, the most important thing was that he was Hu Tian’s second brother, his brother-in-law!

Thus, Lin Fan said, “Wait for me!”

One had to know…

Lin Fan had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience. It was definitely not a problem for him to treat his injuries.

Furthermore, Lin Fan had Medical Water, which was a magical treasure that could cure illnesses.

After Lin Fan hung up the phone, he said to Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the other students, “I have something to do and will be out for a few days. If you have any questions, you can ask the other professors or wait for me to come back to solve them.”

After saying that, he quickly walked out.

Lil White, who was eating premium beef cat food, shouted, “Goodbye, Master!”

At this moment, the computer science professors Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei walked over with a copy of Nature.

They were about to say something when Lin Fan left them with a figure that was quickly disappearing into the distance.

“This…”

Qiu Junxiong couldn’t help but be stunned.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu noticed the two of them and walked over. He said excitedly, “Are you guys here to discuss The Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets with Professor Lin?

“Professor Lin has something urgent to attend to and will be away for a few days.

“I’m Professor Lin’s student, Hao Zhiwu. I know a little about this.”

Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei looked at each other and nodded. “Alright.”

“What does this mean?” Hao Zhiwu pointed at a chart.

“And this algorithm…”

“This thing…”

Very soon… Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei realized that Hao Zhiwu did not know anything.

He did not know anything at all!

He did not even understand the thesis at all!

He wanted to explain the thesis to them?

Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei did not know whether to laugh or cry.

If he had completely understood the thesis, it would have been fine.

The problem was that he had not fully understood the thesis.

Therefore, Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei only chatted for a while before finding an excuse to leave the office.

After all…

As teachers, it was not good for students to feel that their knowledge was shallow and that they could not even understand a paper.

When Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei were holding Nature magazine and walking toward the teaching building with smiles on their faces, Wang Jun, who was also a computer science professor, happened to walk over.

Wang Jun looked at their proud backs and sighed. “A few days ago, Qiu Junxiong didn’t recruit a new student. Instead, he dragged Lin Fan to the laboratory.

“If only I had discovered it earlier… The Principles and Future of Gaming Helmets!”

Wang Jun shook the Nature journal in his hand and let out a long sigh.

His heart was filled with regret.

If he had discovered it earlier, perhaps his name would have appeared as the second author.
